messages:
deploy-bot: EMERGENCY deploy STARTED — tagged release `hotfix/2026-03-19-tokenizer-fix-1` -> production (service: inference-api). Reason: widespread 400s for short prompts reported since 21:40 UTC. Change window: OUT-OF-HOURS. Canary plan: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Commit: `7f3a9b2`. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/7f3a9b2
simon: oncall flagged this. SLO impact visible in Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/alerts/err-rate — errors spiking to 1.8% on inference-api. Need expedited patch. Who's owning rollout?
ashley: I can own deploy. Patch is a tokenizer tweak + pinned tokenizer artifact (redwood-token-v1.9). No DB migrations. Quick smoke tests included in job.
matt: verified unit/integration on canary image locally. patch fixes token boundary for edge case. No schema changes.
ops-oncall: heads-up — I'll enable stricter monitoring and pager if error-rate > 0.5% or 95p latency > 600ms. Will watch infra autoscale.
cto-jen: approved emergency rollout. @simon — escalate to customers if outage continues > 15m. :exclamation:
simon: proceeding on owner ack. starting canary at 21:46 UTC -> 2% traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed: 2% traffic, instances updated (tag `hotfix/2026-03-19-tokenizer-fix-1`). Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/streams/7f3a9b2
matt: quick checks: no 400s in canary traces for the failing prompts, tokenization test vector all green.
ops-oncall: infra looks stable, error-rate on canary = 0.03%, control cluster still at 1.7% (expected). Proceeding to 20% in 3m.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 20% traffic.
ashley: running synthetic load for legacy clients against canary. no regresses so far. latency steady.
ops-oncall: alert noise reduced. overall prod error-rate dropping to 0.4% in last 5m.
cto-jen: thanks team. once at 20% and metrics stable, go to 100% and tag in release notes.
simon: rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. All instances on `hotfix/2026-03-19-tokenizer-fix-1`. Completed at 21:55 UTC. Deployed by @ashley. Deployment runbook: https://runbook.redwood/deploy-hotfix
release-bot: Release note draft created: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-19-hotfix-tokenizer-fix (short note + CVE-none + rollback instructions). Please review.
ops-oncall: post-deploy checks: error-rate 0.05%, 95p latency +5ms, CPU normal. No pager triggers. :thumbsup:
matt: added pinned model entry to service config: `model_pin: redwood-token-v1.9` and checksum verified `sha256: c34be9...`.
simon: decision: mark this hotfix as tagged release and pin inference-api to the patched tokenizer until next scheduled maintenance to allow downstream clients to catch up.
ashley: opening follow-up ticket INF-2389: test coverage for tokenizer edge corpus and backward compatibility test harness for legacy clients.
release-bot: Post-deploy checklist complete and changelog updated. Customer-notify draft queued for legal review (SLA email if needed).
simon: closing thread. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :clap:
deploy-bot: NOTE: rollback steps are in runbook; in case of fallout, run `deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-tag release/2026-03-12-v1.4.6`
